title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War II — What Science Actually Says #Shorts
description:
Strip Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War II of its poetry and the mechanism underneath is stranger. Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War II is a real-time tactics and tactical role-playing video game based on Games Workshop's fictional Warhammer 40,000 universe, developed by Relic Entertainment and published by THQ for Microsoft Windows. Dawn of War II was released in North America on February 19, 2009, and in Europe on February 20, 2009, with two expansions Chaos Rising and Retribution being released in 2010 and 2011, respectively.

Nihilism is not the conclusion of Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War II — it is the floor you stand on while examining it. The game opens with the player and Sergeant Tarkus deep-striking onto the desert planet Calderis to aid Captain Davian Thule and his initiates. As they drive away the Orks they are confronted by Mek Badzappa and his wartrukk.
